# SQLite amalgamation provenance

This directory vendors only the unmodified `sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h` files
from the official SQLite 3.53.4 amalgamation archive:

- Source: `https://www2.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip`
- Archive SHA3-256: `628a44cfe82c66aed1ccbbe85a562d2e33ebe64b3288981ed76285612227934e`
- SQLite release: 3.53.4 (2026-07-24)

The archive hash was verified before these two files were copied into the
repository. SQLite is dedicated to the public domain. See
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and <https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html>.
